verdict.rationale: Recurly is a subscription-billing SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes external servers' tools falls outside its product role. The documented Recurly Compass MCP is a server that exposes Recurly to external agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor. That is the opposite role and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. The pack contains no evidence that Recurly has a built-in agent able to connect to MCP servers.
